notes: §1985:VI.6.27.3 SR7: 'Identifier-1 must not be reference modified.' VersionConformancePass.VisitUnstringStatement gates the construct unstring-sender-reference-modified-2002 (COBOL0900 below 2002), but only on the dataReference alternative of strUnstrSender: a data-name sender written SRC (1:5), SRC (1:), SRC OF G (1:5) or SRT (I) (I:5) is refused at 85 (probed), and a subscripted or qualified sender without a reference modifier is accepted. The functionCall alternative is never asked, so a reference-modified function-identifier (§1985:IV.4.3.8.3.3 SR2 'A reference-modifier may be specified only for functions of the category alphanumeric'; SR3 admits an alphanumeric function-identifier where an identifier is permitted) is accepted as identifier-1 at 85. Implemented for the data-name operand shape, not for the function-identifier shape. The witness refuses UNSTRING SRC (1:5) with COBOL0900.

next.reason: 1985: "Identifier-1 must not be reference modified."; 2023: "No rule in 14.9.48.3 (SR-1 to SR-10) forbids reference modification of identifier-1; only a variable-length group is barred". The 2023 UNSTRING syntax rules, which appear complete, restrict identifier-1 only by category and variable-length group. The ban on reference modification is dropped.
